art_direction: 白金海风 · 绯珊瑚晴台：27岁成年原创女性，珍珠白长发、冰蓝双眼和绯珊瑚红夏裙，近景侧身拢发直视镜头，以群青晴空、青绿海水和玫红花卉衬托精致面容。
composition_variation: Eye-level close head-to-upper-thigh portrait, gentle head tilt, one hand tucking hair behind an ear and the other resting on a seaside terrace railing. Large legible face with both eyes visible and clean sky at the top.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved outside the repository in Codex task artifact directory jewel-white-hair-wallpaper/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized.

wallpaper.hair: Pearl-white long hair with pale silver-lavender shadows and delicate warm rim light
wallpaper.title: 白金海风 · 绯珊瑚晴台
wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Inspected compressed 589x1280 JPEG of the canonical wallpaper. One adult original woman with clear pearl-white hair, large refined face, readable blue eyes and a natural slight smile. Raised hand tucks hair by the ear with coherent visible fingers; the other forearm rests at the terrace railing and its hand is occluded. Opaque coral short-sleeved dress, deep blue sky, turquoise sea and magenta flowers. Clear upper sky, no text, watermark or unwanted people.

visible_description: 珍珠白长发、冰蓝双眼的成年女性穿绯珊瑚红短袖夏裙，在海边石栏旁拢起耳侧发丝，近景直视镜头浅笑；群青晴空与青绿海水衬托白发和明亮面容。
